metadata.title: Hosting Model Trust

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for establishing explicit trust assumptions based on where computing platforms are physically hosted and operationally managed.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Physical hosting environments including institutional data centers, co-location facilities, third-party managed hosting, and sovereign cloud regions.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for defining environmental and operational trust assumptions for infrastructure hosting models.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Initial access risks arising from physical access, hosting provider compromise, or unauthorized facility access.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Credential access risks due to exposure of management systems or personnel with privileged facility access.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Impact to availability or integrity resulting from facility outage, environmental failure, or hosting provider incident.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of externally exposed management or hosting service interfaces.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts associated with hosting providers or facility operations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privileged access management for personnel and systems with hosting-level control.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Environmental and facility resilience measures to reduce impact of physical or operational disruption.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Administrative and operational separation of duties within hosting and facility management.

metadata.remarks: Hosting Model Trust defines the trust assumptions derived from the physical location, ownership, and operational control of infrastructure hosting environments. This pattern does not prescribe physical security controls; instead, it makes environmental trust boundaries explicit so that higher-level platform and system trust decisions are made with clear awareness of hosting context.

components.title: Hosting Environment Classification
components.description: Classifies infrastructure based on hosting ownership, operational responsibility, and jurisdiction.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Hosting environments are identified and categorized to support appropriate trust assumptions.

components.title: Operational Control Boundaries
components.description: Defines boundaries between institutional, provider, and third-party operational responsibilities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Operational roles and responsibilities for hosting environments are explicitly defined and understood.
